info.title: API.SH: Propwire
info.description: The Propwire API from API.SH: public Propwire data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Propwire's place search: cities, ZIP codes, counties and street addresses matching a text, with the property id, link, APN and coordinates for addresses (use the id with the property, comps and market endpoints).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/propwire-autocomplete

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text to match, e.g. `1600 Pennsylvania Ave` or `Austin`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Comparable properties around one property, as the site's comps view finds them: same property type within a radius, sold in the last N months (or pending / for sale / any status), with distance in miles from the subject. Accepts the same property filters as search (beds, baths, size, year built, value...). Returns the subject property summary and the comps with sale date and price, estimated value, beds, baths, area, year built and coordinates. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/propwire-comps

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Propwire property id (the number in a propwire.com/realestate/<address>/<id> link), e.g. `88450`.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Or a US street address, e.g. `1600 NW 64th St, Miami, FL 33147` (matched with the site's address search).

parameters.name: same_type
parameters.description: Only the subject's property type (default true).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Skip this many results (pass `next_offset` back; null on the last page). `page` also works.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The local market report of a property's area (or of a ZIP and its city): monthly trends over 1, 3 or 5 years (median sale and list price, price per sq ft, homes sold, pending sales, new listings, inventory, months of supply, median days on market, sale-to-list ratio, share sold above list, price drops, off market in two weeks, each with month-over-month and year-over-year change), the latest figures for the city, county, ZIP and neighbourhood, and the city's area profile (population, density, age, income, home value, rent, home ownership, education, employment, commute). Market figures are sourced from Redfin, as the site shows them.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/propwire-market

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Propwire property id: the report for its area and property type, e.g. `88450`.

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: Or a 5-digit ZIP: the report for that ZIP and its city.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: With `zip`: the city (taken from the ZIP when left out).

parameters.name: county

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: With `zip`: two-letter state code (taken from the ZIP when left out).

parameters.name: neighborhood
parameters.description: Neighbourhood name for the neighbourhood card, when the site has one.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.source_note: Market figures as the site shows them (sourced from Redfin).

get.description:
Public business contact details for the owner of one US property, only when that owner is a business entity (LLC, corporation, partnership, bank, developer, management company and the like). The owner is treated as a business only when every owner name is a business-entity name and the property record agrees; individuals, couples, trusts, estates and anything unclear answer `owner.owner_type: "individual"` with `contacts: null` and a `note`, and no registry or directory lookups are made for them.

For a business owner: the owner names, entity name, mailing address, property count, portfolio value and linked property ids from the property record; the state business registry record from free public registries (the property's state and the mailing address's state; Florida Division of Corporations, California Secretary of State, Texas Comptroller taxable-entity search, and the New York, Colorado and Oregon public business registers): registry name and id, status, entity type, formation date, jurisdiction, registered agent name and address, principal and mailing address, officers or managers by name and title as the registry lists them, and a registry link; the entity's LEI record when it has one; and a business phone and website from public business directories (BBB and Google Maps), given only when a listing has the same entity name at the owner's mailing or registry address (same street number and ZIP, or the exact name with suffix in the same city and state), otherwise null. `sources` lists every source tried with `found`, `no_match`, `unavailable` (did not answer in time; that section is null) or `not_covered` (no free registry for that state yet).

No personal phone numbers or personal email addresses are returned for anyone; officers are listed by name only.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Calls where `contacts` is null (an individual, trust, public-body or hidden owner; nothing is looked up) cost 1 credit instead of the full price.

Price: 5 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/propwire-owner-contacts

parameters.description: Propwire property id (the number in a propwire.com/realestate/<address>/<id> link), e.g. `88475`.

parameters.name: address

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One US property on Propwire: address, county, coordinates, APN, property type and use, subdivision, zoning, legal description, beds, baths, living/building/lot area, year built, stories, building, interior, exterior, parking, garage, basement and amenity details, estimated value, equity and price per sq ft, tax assessment (assessed and market values, tax amount, exemptions, delinquency), owner names, owner type, owner-occupied flag, years owned and mailing address as on the county record, the owner's property count and portfolio value, open mortgages, mortgage history, sale/transfer history (buyer, seller, price, deed type), listing history with agent, foreclosure notice details, property list types and photos, plus `raw`. Where the site hides the owner (`owner_hidden: true`) owner fields are null.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/propwire-property

get.description:
Search US property records on Propwire by city, county, ZIP or a point and radius, with every filter of the site's search panel: property type, beds, baths, stories, building and lot size, year built, vacancy, features, absentee or out-of-state owner, owner type, cash buyer, years owned, tax delinquency, owner portfolio, estimated value, equity and equity %, assessed values, last sale price and date, private lender, foreclosure status, auction and notice dates, listing status, days on market, list price, listing keywords, foundation, roof, siding and property lists (absentee owners, high equity, free and clear, pre-foreclosure, vacant, tired landlords and more), sorted by value, equity, sale or list price. Each property has id, link, address, type, beds, baths, living/building/lot area, year built, estimated value, equity and LTV, last sale date and price, assessed value, owner names and mailing address as on the county record, owner-occupied flag, years owned, list types, listing status/price/days on market and coordinates, plus `raw`. `total` is the full match count and `lead_type_counts` counts each list in the area. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page (the site serves the first 10,000 results of a search).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/propwire-search

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
